```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
# Add any other libraries here



```


```{r load-data}
rawdata <- read_csv("data/ames.csv")
View(rawdata)


```


```{r data}

# median of house prices
median_price <- median(rawdata$price, 
                       na.rm = TRUE)

mean_price <- mean(rawdata$price,
                   na.rm = TRUE)

# histogram with different house prices!
ggplot(rawdata, aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 20000,
    fill = "lightcyan",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
    geom_vline(
    xintercept = median_price,
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
    geom_vline(
    xintercept = mean_price,
    colour = "orange",
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  labels = scales::comma,
  breaks = seq(0, max(rawdata$price, na.rm = TRUE), by = 100000)
) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of House Prices in Ames, Iowa",
    x = "House Price ($)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# analysis - graph is positively skewed. Mean > Median > Mode
# this means that most house prices are below the mean
# this means that most people earn moderate amounts but a few earn very high incomes

# Scatterplot graphs for relationships
# Preparing data
data <- rawdata %>%
  select(price, area, Year.Built, Yr.Sold, Year.Remod.Add) %>%
  na.omit()

options(scipen = 999)


# Graph 1: Price vs Area
p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = area, y = price)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "House Price vs Area",
    x = "Area",
    y = "House Price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p1)


# Graph 2: Price vs Year Built
p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Year.Built, y = price)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "House Price vs Year Built",
    x = "Year Built",
    y = "House Price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p2)


# Graph 3: Price vs Year Sold
p3 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(Yr.Sold), y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "purple",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "House Price Distribution by Year Sold",
    x = "Year Sold",
    y = "House Price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p3)


# Graph 4: Price vs Year Remodelled
p4 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Year.Remod.Add, y = price)) +
  geom_point(color = "orange", size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "House Price vs Year Remodelled",
    x = "Year Remodelled",
    y = "House Price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p4)


# Correlations calculations
correlations <- data %>%
  summarise(
    Price_Area_Cor = cor(price, area),
    Price_Yr_Built_Cor = cor(price, Year.Built),
    Price_Yr_Sold_Cor = cor(price, Yr.Sold),
    Price_Yr_Remodelled_Cor = cor(price, Year.Remod.Add)
  )

print(correlations)


```
